facts.fact: The temple’s access page distinguishes JR and Kintetsu Nara stations and gives city-bus approaches including Todaiji Daibutsuden / Kasuga Taisha-mae.
facts.location: Visible source paragraph/table containing: Kasuga Taisha
facts.excerpt: Station” Approximately 80 minutes ●By bus ① From JR Nara Station / Kintetsu Nara Station, get off at the city circulation bus “Tōdai-ji Daibutsuden / Kasuga Taisha-mae” and walk for 5 minutes ② From Kintetsu Nara Station, get off at “Daibutsuden-mae Parking Lot” on the round bus (Omiya Street Route / Nara Park Route) .cls-1{fill:#b32b01;} By train and on foot From Kintetsu Nara Station, walk east on Noborioji-cho for about 20 minutes. View Larger Map .cls-1{fill:#b32b01;} By car There is no parking lot at Tōdai-ji Temple. Please use the nearby parking lot.
